# Delane

> Poet, author and mental-health advocate from Moss Point, Mississippi. Her work centers on mental health, faith, identity, healing and self-worth. She shares her poetry through spoken-word performances and digital platforms, where she has an online community of more than 20,000 followers.

## Work
- Poetry books: You Don't Have to Die to Matter; The Kitchen Doesn't Stay Clean for Long: A Book of Poems; The Lane's Heart Vol. 1
- Available for speaking engagements, poetry performances, school visits, literary events, podcast interviews and virtual events
- Especially interested in working with students and young adults on poetry, mental health and creative expression
